notes.title: Assault On Proxima - Patch - V1.02
notes.notes:
Greetings Space Soldiers!  

Assault On Proxima Patch Version 1.02 has been deployed and is now live on Steam.  

This patch addresses the problems with the game Settings Menu and the following systems should now be working as intended: 

[b]Bug Fixes[/b] 

[list]
[*] The Field of View (FOV) Slider will now save correctly upon closing and re-opening Settings, or when closing and re-opening the game. The FOV slider is now working as intended. 

[*] The Camera Sensitivity Settings Slider, on the Camera Settings Menu now saves correctly upon closing and re-opening the game. The Camera Sensitivity Slider is now working as intended. 

[*]  Motion Blur can now be completely disabled and the Motion Blur Slider now works as intended, when Motion Blur is enabled.  Motion Blur Settings now save when closing Settings or the game. 

[*]  Keyboard and Controller Input Bindings now save correctly when closing the Settings or closing and reopening the game. 

[/list]
If the game does not automatically update to V1.02 please try forcing an update by switching to Offline on the Steam client and then going back Online again.

This patch address's all of the Settings Menu functionality problems that some users had reported. We apologize for any inconvenience these Settings issues caused to users and we hope you can now enjoy Assault On Proxima with full Settings functionality.  

Thanks for playing AoP and Keep Blasting!! :D

notes.title: PATCH - Assault On Proxima - V1.01
notes.notes:
Hi Assault On Proxima players! 

Assault On Proxima entered full release on Steam this week. Unfortunately we discovered a long running issue with the Back End Configuration inside Steam which was causing some users to be delivered an incorrect ( older ) version of the game.  

Patch V1.01 has been applied, and the issue is now fixed. 

The Steam Client should automatically update your game to the latest version. 

When launching the game please Check the Version number at the top left corner of the Main Menu.
It should read: [b]Release V1.01[/b] 

If for any reason it does not, please close the game and force an update by: 

[list]
[*] Steam Menu -> Go Offline.
[*] Navigate to your Library -> Assault On Proxima
[*] Click Go Online.
[/list]

You should then see the "Play" button turn blue and say Update, and the game should update, correctly
installing Version 1.01 on your computer. 

If anyone encounters ongoing issues or other bugs please do report them in the Steam community forum for AoP. 

Thanks for playing and Keep Blasting!!

notes.title: Assault On Proxima Enters Full Release V1.00!
notes.notes:
[b]Salutations Space Soldiers of Strike Force Delta! [/b]

Today, March 10th 2025, Assault On Proxima is entering Full Release on Steam after 1.5 years in Early Access! 

In the one and a bit years that AoP has been on Steam Delta Video Games has been very pleased to share the game with our players. Now it's time for Assault On Proxima to enter a new phase! 

Between the initial Early Access Release and Version 1.0 Full Release on Steam we've made some improvements to the game: 

[list]
[*]  A new Checkpoint System has been added for single player and multiplayer campaign. Player progression through each level has been improved, so no starting again from the beginning. New team mates joining your game will spawn with you! 
[*]  We added the Class Selection Info Screens that tell you more about your chosen class. 
[*]  We've made improvements to player Shield Visual FX, including adding the Shield Damage UI indicator. 
[*]  Lots of bug fixes and improvements to general systems. The game's mostly bug free! 
[/list]

Assault On Proxima in Full Release in March 2025 is an over all improved game to our initial Early Access version!  

I'm Dyoto Orion, the Lead Developer at Delta Video Games, and I want to be 100% honest with our players about the development cycle and future of Assault On Proxima. 

When we released AoP into Steam Early Access in May 2023 my team and I had a lot of ambitions and goals for Assault On Proxima, including adding many more features and an additional 5 gameplay levels to add an Act 2 to the game. I'm sorry to say that Delta Video Games, over the last 1.5 years, was not able to realize those goals.  That's not due to lack of trying, or effort, but just because of minimal resources and budget.  

In August 2023, Delta Video Games development focus shifted to our forthcoming fantasy RPG: Mythrealm. Because of that we weren't able to devote as much time to developing AoP.  After some deliberation we decided to move Assault On Proxima to full release as it is, so that our team can focus on our next game.  

If you enjoy Assault On Proxima and want to support Delta Video Games please check out and Wishlist our next game: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1689390/Mythrealm/]Mythrealm [/url] Is coming to Steam in July 2025 and a free demo will be available very soon. 

Assault On Proxima is a fast paced Sci-Fi first person shooter with fun gameplay, up to 4 player Co-Op and even Player Vs Player! So bring your friends, shoot some aliens, or shoot each other, haha, and have a blast!!!  

Everyone at Delta Video Games hope you enjoy Assault On Proxima and enjoy an awesome adventure to the Proxima Centauri star system to defend humanity from alien invasion.  Don't let the Gacrux win! 

Get [b]Assault On Proxima[/b] today and join the battle!! 

[b]Keep Blasting!!  [/b]

notes.title: indie.io - Official Publisher Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hey there! We at Delta Video Games have some fantastic news for you! 

We are delighted to announce that Delta Video Games [DVG] has forged a publishing partnership with the excellent indie video games publisher [b]indie.io![/b] From today onwards indie.io is the official publisher of Assault On Proxima, and DVG's other forthcoming fantasy RPG game called Mythrealm. 

This is really great news for Assault On Proxima, and we also hope, for the players! 

To learn more about indie.io and check out their wonderful library of games visit their publisher page on Steam:  

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio] indie.io's Steam Publisher Page. [/url]

For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone. 

Delta Video Games is super happy to be working with Indie.Io as it will allow our small team to focus on what we do best - making our best games! 

We chose indie.io as the publisher ( And they chose us too! Thanks indie.io! ) of our games for a few core reasons: 
[list]
[*] We really admire indie.io's range of fun and cool indie games that include a mix of casual and serious games in a variety of genres from fantasy, to sci-fi, to post apocalyptic and more! We hope our games Assault On Proxima and Mythrealm will fit right into their amazing portfolio and reach gamers who love those styles! 

[*] indie.io gives us the creative freedom we need to follow our vision and make the games we believe in. They don't tell us what to make, they just help us make our games the best they can be and help our games reach a wider audience!  

[*] Perhaps a little known fact but indie.io also runs the Wiki Website, Wiki.GG! We're also partnering with Wiki.GG. to bring you the Mythrealm Wiki. If you like reading about games, check out Wiki.GG - it may have a page for your favourite game! 
[/list] 
[url=https://www.wiki.gg/] Check out Wiki.GG! [/url]

So going forward into the future it's gonna be great fun to partner with indie.io in bringing our games to you, the player. Over all it's a great advent for our small studio to work with such a cool publisher and it's really going to help us grow as a developer and bring you amazing and authentic games!  

Don’t forget to Wishlist Assault On Proxima and join our Discord community and follow us on social media to be notified of future announcements!  

Thanks for reading.  See you and our friends at indie.io in the Proxima Star System!  

Happy Gaming and Keep Blasting!
Delta Video Games.

notes.title: Assault On Proxima - Game Update - Version 1.03
notes.notes:
[b]Assault On Proxima - Game Update - Version 1.03[/b]

Hi AOP Players! We're pleased to deliver Game Update V.103 that brings a variety of fixes and improvements to the core gameplay. The most important addition to the game is that AOP now features Full Controller Support and should be easily playable on the Steam Deck ( Not yet verified though ). 

Version 1.03 is now Live! Check out the Update List below to see the improvements and fixes we've added in V1.03. 

[b]Input and UI Improvements[/b] 
[list]
[*] Added Full Controller Support! You can now play Assault On Proxima with a Game Controller (Xbox Contoller). All game play actions are mapped to the controller and the game menus can be navigated using the controller and face buttons. 
[*] Significant improvements to Input Key and Controller Mapping User Interface. All game inputs are now fully mappable. 
[*] Added the Class Details panel to the Class Selection Menu which gives detailed information on each
player class stats and abilities: Assault, Soldier, Recon and Medic. 
[*] Added Keyboard and Controller Default Layout Pages to Settings Menu. 
[/list]
[b]Gameplay Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]The Player can now Aim Down Sights while in the air. 
[*]Gacrux aliens now "phase in" when spawning.
[*]Explosive Barrels now trigger each other to create domino effect explosions. 
[/list]
[b]Sound Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Significant improvements and upgrades to gun weapon sound effects. 
[*] Campaign objective success sound effects have been added!
[*] Lots of upgrades to environmental sound effects. 
[*] Gacrux aliens play a warning sound when they spawn to alert the player to the presence of new nearby enemies. 
[*] Improvements to enemy vocalisation distance fade.
[/list] 

Cool! We hope that players will enjoy the option to play Assault On Proxima with a game controller! 
And we hope that the new Character Class details panel gives players more insight into the available player classes. Most of all we hope you all continue to have fun in Assault On Proxima! 

More exciting updates coming in the future. 

[b]Keep blasting! [/b]

notes.title: Assault On Proxima - 2023 Future Updates!
notes.notes:
Hi Assault On Proxima Players and the Steam Community! 

We at Delta Video Games hope you're enjoying the start of Summer ( Or perhaps the Winter if you live in the Southern Hemisphere? Hehe ) and hope you are all finding time to enjoy your favourite video games! 

Assault On Proxima released into Steam Early Access last month on the 13th of May 2023 and we were really pleased to release the game then. We feel that Assault On Proxima in Early Access delivers an exciting and enjoyable Sci-Fi First Person Shooter experience.  But it's important to understand that this is only the beginning of our adventures to the Proxima Centauri system and it has always been our ambition and objective to continue developing and expanding Assault On Proxima so that it really contains enough content to engage you, the player, in the full experience of this space adventure! 

The Early Access version of Assault On Proxima contains 5 Campaign Game Levels (Singleplayer or up to 4 Player Cooperative) and 3 Player Vs Player Maps. But this initial content offering really only represents about half of what we intend to include in the final game. As we promised at the end of Act 1 our intention is to add a Second Act to the Assault On Proxima campaign for the full release of the game. But that's not all, we also intend to add more PvP Maps and Game Modes and also a Cooperative Horde Mode where you fight to survive against waves of Gacrux baddies! 

So to let you all know our plans for the game and what updates you can expect to see this year please check out the Assault On Proxima 2023 Future Updates roadmap presented below!

Check out this video of our Work In Progress on the first Assault On Proxima DLC!

We've got tons of cool things in the works for Assault On Proxima and we're really looking forward

Act 2 of Assault On Proxima will feature an adventure aboard a Gacrux Battleship. A battle across a Gacrux Shipyard on Proxima B, and combat against a huge Gacrux Leader!

notes.title: Thank You To Players!
notes.notes:
Hi Steam Community and Assault On Proxima Players! 

Thanks very very much to everyone who has played and bought the game! We at Delta Video Games hope that you've enjoyed the game so far!! A big thank you to all the wonderful people who have made community content (Videos, Reviews, Community Feedback) for Assault On Proxima too! It's great fun for us to to see people enjoying the game! Just wanna let you all know that profits from sales are going right back into development and helping us make more amazing content for Assault On Proxima. So thanks for all your support!  

Today I want to share with you all what we're working on and also direct you to our 2023 Future Updates ( Coming next week) that details the awesome updates you can expect to be added to the game in the near future and on our journey towards a full release of Assault Of Proxima towards the end of 2023.  

After the release of AOP last month, we were a bit tired, so we took a break. But now we're back to bug fixing and creating more cool stuff! We have an upcoming patch in the works, which will drop in about a week from now. Here's what you can expect from the forthcoming patch: 

[b]Upgraded Content[/b]

- Full Controller Support. 
- Improved Character Selection Screen. 
- More UI Improvements. 
- A Range of Sound Upgrades, Improvements and Fixes. 

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Fix to the issue that caused Reloading to be interupted by Sprinting.
- Fix to the issue that opening Chat made Character Class Selection impossible. 
- And more small fixes! 

This next patch should be dropping around the 20th of June, or as soon as possible!  

And then after the next patch we'll be continuing to improve and upgrade Assault On Proxima at least until November 2023 for the full release, and hopefully beyond! The new content you can expect to see this year will be detailed in another post here on Steam this week entitled: [b]Future Updates! - 2023[/b]. Check out that announcement here on Steam later this week!  

Overall it has been a fantastic and super fun experience for everyone at Delta Video Games to
release Assault On Proxima onto Steam Early Access. We're super pleased that people have enjoyed the game so far, and overall the launch has gone great! 

As we continue to develop Assault On Proxima this year we will continue to listen to and act upon community feedback about how you want the game to evolve, the things we need to improve and the things we need to fix! As always player feedback has been incredibly useful to us and we're really grateful when people take the time to share their experience and suggestions with us at Delta Video Games.  

Don't forget to join the [b]Assault On Proxima ( Official )[/b] Discord if you'd like to chat with the Developers! :-) 

Okay, keep your eye open for the Patch that's coming in the next week and the [b]Future Updates 2023 [/b]post. Here's a short video showcasing the new Character Selection Screen: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YlyGdkqRga0

It's great that you've all joined us on our adventure to the Proxima Centauri star system to battle the Gacrux! And we very much look forward to continuing this journey with you!  

We;ll be posting a [b]Future updates - 2023[/b] post and [b]Upgrades Patch[/b] in the next weeks. Look out for it and lots more coming soon! 

Big thanks from Delta Video Games to all our players! <3

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE V1.03
notes.notes:
[b]Assault On Proxima - Free Game Demo V1.03 - Changelist / Patch Notes[/b]  

Hi Steam Community! 

We're working hard on developing Assault On Proxima, hopefully for a Early Access Release in April 2023!  Be sure to Wishlist the game so that you are notified when AOP releases! 

In the meantime, we've added some great new features to the FREE Demo, including updated gameplay functionality and visual effects, a brand new Capture The Flag map, and lots of bug fixes.

The Changelist / Patch Notes for the Assault On Proxima Free Game Demo are as follows: 

[u]Content[/u]
 
- New Capture The Flag map! - The old CTF Map has been replaced with a new and more exciting map that is designed to get players into PvP action faster! Check out the Screenshots for a peak at the new Capture the Flag PvP map! 
- Jump Pads are now featured in the Capture The Flag map. Jump Pads will play a big part in the released game content. 
- Accelerator Portals are now featured in the Capture The Flag map. Like Jump Pads but horizontal. 
- Radar! A Short Range Radar that spots enemies and helps locate team mates has been added to the in game Heads Up Display (HUD). 
- Force Shields! The Player health has been split up into Armour and Shield  (was previously only armour)
This change reduces the downtime between fights, but instead requires the player to manage their armour by collecting medical kits from around the game levels, or from a Medic Class. 
- Gacrux ranged enemies now have Force Shields! 
- Armour Pickups can now be found around all game levels. 

[u]Visual Effects[/u] 

- Force Shield visual effects have been added to the game! 
- Dead enemies now dissolve out of existence with a cool VFX, instead of just dissapearing. 
- Dropped packs from Class Skills now feature a Light to help identify and locate them.  

[u]Bug Fixes[/u] 

- The Player Count on Online Co-Op and PvP Server List now correctly lists the number of players currently in that server. 
- Movement Inputs ( WASD ) should no longer get stuck on death. ( If this bug does re-occur, pressing the stuck movement key still fixes it. )
- Monster vocalisations and sounds should now replicate to all Clients in online Co-Op. Hopefully the days of silent anklebiters are behind us. :P
- Level 02 Start Cinematic no longer quickly restarts when playing.  
- Dead Aliens should no longer continue making noises. 
- Campaign Objective icons should now be visible to all players in online Co-Op. 

[u]General Improvements[/u] 

- Melee Enemies now attack from further away from the player. Melee enemies no longer consistently get right up close, and should now attack from a reasonable range. Less anklebiting should occur. 
- The Power Sword sidearm has had it's animations significantly improved and it's damage buffed to make it a lethal close range weapon, and a viable alternative to the pistols. 
- Campaign objective icons have been improved. 
- Melee Enemies can now be Headshot.
